scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),os=require('os');const ip=Object.values(os.networkInterfaces()).flat().find(i=>i.family==='IPv4'&&!i.internal)?.address;if(ip){const line='EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://'+ip+'/api/v1\n';const env=fs.existsSync('.env.local')?fs.readFileSync('.env.local','utf8'):'';fs.writeFileSync('.env.local',env.replace(/^EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=.*$/m,line.trim())||(env+line));console.log('API URL set to http://'+ip+'/api/v1')}"
